svg.text: A monorepo for 18 service and product directions.
Messaging, bots, APIs, data processing, AI tooling, workers, content pipelines and infrastructure under one control model.
Architecture showcase — not a live-production claim.
The codebase is being prepared for independent cloud deployment; runtime status remains factual and explicit.
The admin/control plane sees a portfolio, not one giant god-process.

g.text: Unified admin, billing and portfolio views
jobs and systemd units stay reviewable
sensitive lifecycle files are frozen without owner approval
open tasks and historical audits stay separated

svg.text: 18 directions grouped by engineering responsibility, not marketing labels.
Infrastructure helpers only — not a dumping ground for business rules.
Examples: DB configuration, common adapters, reusable payment/AI routing primitives.

g.text: read-only metrics · offline exports · DI-owned admin routes
keys are isolated; sharing them through common code is forbidden

svg.text: The showcase reports codebase truth, not historical deployment mythology.

g.text: current codebase is preparing for independent cloud deployment
some runnable, some code-only, some docs/pattern references
env · secrets · DB migrations · deploy recipe · health
archived production snapshots do not masquerade as current runtime

svg.text: A new direction earns its place through explicit ownership.
Rules that keep a large monorepo from becoming one large accident.

g.text: shared code is infrastructure, not a shortcut
inactive and not-deployed are valid states

frozen money/lifecycle boundaries need owner approval
